$comment: Sainsbury's (sainsburys.co.uk) tracking config fragments — reference copy only, loaded by nothing. To use, paste the arrays into a study config under tracking.* (contract: docs/config-schema.md §3.1/§3.2; guides: docs/README.md → 'Semantic-group (sg) rules' and 'Force-tracked elements'). semanticGroupRules groups every event inside a product tile under the product name — one rule per markup variant: article[data-testid^='product-tile'] is the older listing tile (name from the description link's title attr, falling back to the tile's data-testid, product-tile-<id>); [data-testid='gw-product-card'] is the newer Fable design-system card (name from the gw-product-name link's title attr, falling back to its text, then the product image alt). The variants' selectors are disjoint, so whichever isn't present on a page is inert. Anchor only on data-testid hooks — the Fable markup's fable:* utility classes, *-module__* CSS-module hashes, React-generated ids (_R_...), and data-pkgid (embeds the design-system version) all change across builds/renders. additionalTrackedElements force-tracks the price spans (heuristics roll them up into the tile text) so prices emit their own appear/click/hover events — with the sg rule active, each price event carries its product's name as sg, and each entry's type becomes the event's eT (price_nectar / price_retail / price_unit) so the three price kinds are distinguishable in the data. Verify selectors against the live DOM before shipping (they are the site's markup, not ours).
